notes: No xtext evidence: the pinned SysML.xtext has no rule of this name, reaching the payload through its own arrangement of AcceptParameterPart.
decision: A transcription of SysML 8.2.2.17.4: `ownedRelatedElement += PayloadParameter`. It contributes no tokens; the payload's own syntax, including the trigger expression forms, is entirely in PayloadParameter. It is the mandatory part of AcceptParameterPart, which is why every accept has a payload even where the text names only a type.

evidence.note: States the production; the rule is its transcription. The pack flags this clause as malformed, but the defect is in TriggerExpression (SYSML21-401) and not in this production.
In line 58 `accept ignitionCmd:IgnitionCmd via ignitionCmdPort` this member holds `ignitionCmd:IgnitionCmd`, the part before 'via'.
In line 17 `then accept S;` it holds the bare type name `S`; in line 18 `then accept sig after 10[SI::s];` a name and a trigger expression.
